points.heading: Three domains, one pattern
points.text: The lecture applies role-based prompting to coding, data analysis, and creative writing. In each case, role, task, format and tone, and examples work together to guide the AI agent.

points.heading: Senior Python Developer role
points.text: The system prompt asks for robust, well-documented code with type hints that follows PEP 8. The user prompt defines the task, such as a memoized Fibonacci function that handles n=0 and n=1, and supplies input/output examples.

points.heading: Marketing Data Analyst role
points.text: The role directs the AI to read sales data through a marketing lens and give actionable insights. The user prompt supplies the data, asks for bullet-point findings and recommendations, and shows an example format for each.

points.heading: Fantasy Author role
points.text: The role sets a style of stark prose, realism within the fantasy setting, and underlying hope. The user prompt adds details such as third-person perspective, sensory focus, foreshadowing, and an approximate length of 30 words.

points.heading: System prompt versus user prompt
points.text: The system prompt holds the role and general instructions when working with an LLM's API. In an app like ChatGPT, you typically combine system and user prompts.

points.heading: Iterate and evaluate results
points.text: If the output is not what you want, refine the prompt and try again. Then check the result against the criteria you set in Evaluating Agent Personas.

points.heading: Core components of a prompt
points.text: The review lists four components: Role defines the specialization, Task details the request, Output Format describes the expected form, and Examples clarify requirements. Layering them gives the AI structure and context to produce tailored outputs.

data.slogan: Define the role, guide the output
data.subtitle: You will see how one prompting pattern guides AI in coding, data analysis, and creative writing.
data.takeaway: Combining a clear role with a defined task, format and tone, and examples lets you guide AI output in any domain.
